title: The Seven-Year King
subtitle: A smut epic fantasy set in modern Britain and Ireland
author: Michael Thomson
epigraph: She never pretends the leash is love.

books.title: Shadow
books.why: Nest has to become home. Forced scene + aftermath. Voluntary PE. Bully-lover. Prologue. Crow at the edge. Deal as the last-chapter wedding. Under 110k the house is a layover.

books.title: Green
books.why: Longest on purpose. War, innocents, nest-enemy, root-kill, willing lovers, then sit in the grief. This is the book that dies if you keep the three volumes even.

books.title: Crow
books.why: Green-enemy, unused years, last night, both dictators, death, crow. Do not open a new encyclopedia. Do not starve the last night.

title_alternatives: Last Night of the Horned God
